name: Vending Machine
description: Puts the online game's stock back in the Waiting Room vending machine: the faction metals, materials and mushrooms of its daily list and the weekly blueprints, at the online prices, for Kill Coins and Death Metals - or your own list, priced and bundled as you like. Set it in Configuration.
author: KSFA

settings.label: Machine

options.label: As online
options.help: The online machine's goods at its prices, set below under "As online".

options.label: Your own list
options.help: Only what you put on your list, at your prices, set below under "Your own list".

settings.help: Either way the seven things it always sold stay. Switch the mod off for the machine exactly as the game has it.

settings.label: Pay with

options.label: Kill Coins and Death Metals, as online
options.help: Each good for Kill Coins, Death Metals or both, as the online machine sold it. Faction metals and blueprints were Death Metals only, and so are the three cosmetic armours.

options.label: Kill Coins only
options.help: Everything for Kill Coins. Goods sold only for Death Metals online cost the game's own Kill Coin price (a bundle of 5 costs 4).

options.label: Death Metals only
options.help: Everything for Death Metals, at the online prices, and the three cosmetic armours too.

settings.help: Death Metal prices need the Death Metals mod, which gives you Death Metals to spend.

settings.label: Weekly blueprints
settings.help: The 40 blueprints the online machine took turns selling, 8 a week, for Death Metals. Here all of them are on sale at once, one of each a day.

patches.description: The online vending machine's goods on the Buy tab
Your own list of goods on the Buy tab
patches.sql:
DELETE FROM master_automaticshop_lineup WHERE goods_id BETWEEN 90001 AND 199999;
WITH RECURSIVE wanted(place, type_id, pack_count, currency_type, price, a_day) AS (VALUES {{custom}}), sold AS (SELECT * FROM wanted WHERE type_id IN (SELECT itemid FROM master_item) OR type_id IN (SELECT id FROM master_mushroom)), copy(place, n) AS (SELECT place, 1 FROM sold UNION ALL SELECT copy.place, copy.n + 1 FROM copy JOIN sold ON sold.place = copy.place WHERE copy.n < sold.a_day) INSERT INTO master_automaticshop_lineup (goods_id, lineup_id, entity_type, type_id, is_stable, freq, is_special, display_priority, currency_type, stock, pack_count, pack_money, pack_metal, pack_recycle_point, pack_bloodnium, money_discount_rate, metal_discount_rate, recycle_point_discount_rate, bloodnium_discount_rate) SELECT 100000 + sold.place * 32 + copy.n, 'COMMON', CASE WHEN sold.type_id IN (SELECT id FROM master_mushroom) THEN 'MUSHROOM' ELSE 'ITEM' END, sold.type_id, 1, 0, 0, 100 + sold.place, sold.currency_type, CASE WHEN sold.a_day > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, sold.pack_count, CASE WHEN sold.currency_type = 0 THEN sold.price ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN sold.currency_type = 1 THEN sold.price ELSE 0 END, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0 FROM sold JOIN copy ON copy.place = sold.place;
